The announcement followed revelations over the weekend that included Huang’s admission of an extramarital affair. U.S. intelligence agencies believe that Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen and business executive, spied for Beijing, sources told NBC News. Many of Nvidia’s board members have worked alongside Huang for decades and become wealthier with him. But Tuesday’s announcement signaled that Nvidia’s board does not intend its probe to serve as a rubber stamp for Huang’s actions. Wachtell Lipton is one of the nation’s most influential law firms, and its attorneys have track records of taking on corporate titans. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
items.d: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in an affair that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and potentially impact national security. United States officials believe that Huang’s likely romantic interest, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company, had reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. November 9, 2026: Huang pulls out of various speaking engagements The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum. November 9-10, 2026: Details emerge about the business relationships between Nvidia and the alleged spy Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future. items.fullText: 국제 젠슨 황이 불륜녀와 볼키스한 날…젠슨 황 딸이 웃으며 사진 찍어줬다 발행일 : 2026-11-10 21:18 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 젠슨 황의 장녀 매디슨 황. 사진=엑스(X) 캡처. 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO) 젠슨 황이 여성 임원 앨리스 황과 다정하게 포즈를 취하고 볼에 입을 맞추는 장면이 담긴 과거 영상이 다시 주목받고 있다. 당시 두 사람의 모습을 촬영한 인물은 젠슨 황의 장녀 매디슨 황인 것으로 알려졌다. 10일 엑스(X·옛 트위터) 등 SNS에는 젠슨 황이 2025년 5월 22일 대만 타이베이의 식당 산류스푸(三六食府)를 방문했을 당시 영상이 확산했다. 영상에는 업무 만찬 도중 젠슨 황이 앨리스 황을 옆으로 불러 허리를 감싸고 함께 서 있는 모습이 담겼다. 젠슨 황이 앨리스 황의 볼에 입을 맞추는 장면도 포착됐다. 두 사람의 모습을 카메라에 담은 사람은 매디슨 황이었다. 당시 현지 언론에 따르면 매디슨 황은 예비 남편 카프레즈와 함께 같은 식당에 있었다. 앨리스 황과 매디슨 황이 대화를 나누는 모습도 목격됐으며, 매디슨 황은 만찬 참석자들의 사진을 촬영한 것으로 전해졌다. 앨리스 황은 싱가포르 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드 인터내셔널의 임원 출신이다. 최근 외신들은 그가 중국과 연계된 스파이 활동에 관여했을 가능성을 제기하며 젠슨 황과의 관계를 보도했다. 첨단 AI 반도체 관련 정보와 미국 행정부 동향을 수집하기 위해 젠슨 황에게 접근했다는 의혹도 제기됐다. 한편 엔비디아 수석이사로 재직 중인 매디슨 황은 당초 서울 코엑스에서 열린 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026'에 참석할 예정이었으나 방한 일정을 취소했다. 이를 두고 부친을 둘러싼 최근 논란과 관련이 있는 것 아니냐는 관측이 나왔다. 엔비디아 관계자는 매디슨 황의 행사 불참 배경에 대해 “답변하기 어렵다”고 밝혔다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia shares sink while stock market surges The tech giant opened a probe into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia announces investigation into CEO over ties to alleged Chinese spy 02:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 9, 2026, 10:56 AM EST / Updated Nov. 9, 2026, 4:19 PM EST By Steve Kopack and Rob Wile It was a great day for stocks. Just not Nvidia’s. The company’s shares slid 4.2% on Monday after it announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman who U.S. intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. Despite Nvidia’s importance to the AI trade, the news affected almost no other stocks. The Nasdaq 100, which tracks the top tech stocks at the Nasdaq exchange, soared 3.4%. The broader S&P 500 rose 2.3%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose more than 1,100 points. Stocks were also propelled higher by a more than 4% drop in oil prices Monday on news that U.S.--Iran talks were continuing. Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow and the S&P 500. The investigation has the potential to unsettle the entire AI boom, fueled by trillions of dollars of spending and investments, in part to purchase Nvidia’s cutting-edge AI chips. Nvidia’s drop wiped out almost $200 billion in value. Huang, who founded the company more than three decades ago, admitted in a note to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife. “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” Huang’s email also said. items.fullText: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation At the Conference on Robot Learning, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks, built in collaboration with partners, bringing precision and scale to robot training. November 9, 2026 by Sasa Docca 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Simulation, which has long been the proving ground for robots learning to walk, roll and hop, is now helping researchers teach robots tasks that require a finer touch: aligning gears, connecting cables and assembling small components. The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems. At CoRL, NVIDIA is introducing new open robotics technologies, including world action models , simulation tools, benchmarks and agentic workflows. Two NVIDIA papers are among six finalists out of thousands of submissions for the Best Paper Awards at CoRL: GRAIL (Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models), which presents a digital generation pipeline for 3D assets and simulator-ready scenes for robot learning. RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies , which introduces a robot model and training recipe that scales visuomotor context three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies without growing inference latency. These advancements help researchers train robots on complex tasks, evaluate their performance across changing conditions and use failures to guide further learning — building the precision, adaptability and autonomy needed to move from lab demonstrations to industrial deployment. items.fullText: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA November 8, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem. The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles. These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production. Samsung Advances Semiconductor Engineering With Accelerated Computing and AI Physics Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance semiconductor innovation through accelerated computing and AI physics. The work spans materials research, process development and device engineering. In technology computer-aided design, Samsung is working with NVIDIA cuISS and NVIDIA cuDSS to accelerate computations involving sparse linear systems. The collaboration also extends to GPU acceleration for process and optical simulations. In materials research, Samsung’s sMOL platform has run selected quantum chemical calculations up to 5x faster end to end with NVIDIA cuEST . Samsung is also exploring NVIDIA cuEquivariance to speed up tensor operations used in training and inference for atomistic AI models. Samsung is developing chip-scale thermal and mechanical analysis workflows with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo . In one AI homogenization case, combining AI-predicted effective material properties, coarser grids and GPU acceleration resulted in a roughly 1,600x speedup. Simulation time fell from about 18 hours for a fine-grid solve on a 32-core CPU to 41 seconds for a GPU-accelerated coarse-grid solve. Looking ahead, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit could connect these simulation tools and AI models, helping future engineering agents run analyses and compare design options. items.fullText: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets. November 8, 2026 by Nicola Sessions 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents. items.fullText: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration November 8, 2026 by Jesse Clayton 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security. The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization. Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference. In addition, NVIDIA today announced a collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions, supported by MSIT, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure for Korean models and workloads with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion. items.fullText: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production November 8, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies . As models grow beyond the capacity of a single GPU, they must be split across multiple GPUs, requiring careful coordination of request routing and communication to maintain performance. NVIDIA Dynamo is an open source, distributed inference-serving framework built to deploy models in multi-node environments at data center scale. It handles this routing and communication to maximize inference performance. Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box. They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services. Learn more about NVIDIA Dynamo .
